review_required_policy.principle: Never let AI publish silently. Even at 99% confidence. Always Review → Approve → Publish until system earns trust.

workflow_enforcement.trust_threshold: After 50 successful deployments with 0 user corrections

mandatory_steps.name: Upload
mandatory_steps.description: User uploads photos to Incoming Uploads

mandatory_steps.name: Needs Review
mandatory_steps.description: System presents results with confidence scores

mandatory_steps.name: Dry Run
mandatory_steps.description: System shows exactly what will change

prevention_of_silent_publishing.no_auto_publish: System never auto-publishes, regardless of confidence
prevention_of_silent_publishing.no_skip_review: Review step cannot be skipped, even at 100% confidence
prevention_of_silent_publishing.cancel_available: Cancel option always available until final deploy

how_trust_is_earned.reset_condition: Any user correction resets counter to 0

what_happens_when_trust_earned.can_revoke_trust: User can disable auto-publish at any time

confirmation_dialog.title: Confirm Publish
confirmation_dialog.message: This will update the live website. Continue?

safety_guarantees.no_surprises: User always sees exactly what will change before it changes
safety_guarantees.no_silent_updates: Website never updates without explicit human approval
safety_guarantees.instant_rollback: Rollback always available if something goes wrong
safety_guarantees.clear_audit_trail: Every deployment logged with who approved and when
